units: pixels, image coords (x right, y down), time t = frame/50 s

camera.evidence: phase correlation of wall region (x 0-780, y 300-1000) vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.25 px in all 25 frames
camera.view: roughly fronto-parallel to a white door/wall; ball falls in a plane close to the wall, parallel to the image plane

timing_irregularity: Ball step sizes roughly double at frames 7, 12, 17, 22 (every 5th frame) and at 24: one source frame missing there (likely 60->50 fps conversion). Frames 0 and 1 look identical (held). Annotators most likely used the frames as-is at 50 fps.

objects.name: ball
objects.description: grey (taupe), matte ball, the only falling object; held at top centre by a hand, then dropped onto the grey box

size_px.vertical_extent_with_motion_blur: 81 (f8) growing to 90 (f23); not the true size

objects.reference_point: visible centre: mask centroid for frames 8-23; circle fit with r=38 to the unoccluded rim for 0-7; manual for 24

objects.name: hand_arm
objects.description: person's right hand/forearm entering from the top right (grey fleece sleeve at right edge); holds then releases the ball, then moves up/right
objects.visible_frames: 0-24 (fingers only at top edge after frame ~12)
objects.track: tracks/hand.csv (skin-pixel bbox for x<760, y<260; coarse)

objects.name: person_sleeve
objects.description: grey fuzzy fleece sleeve/torso along the right edge, x ~955-1080, full height

objects.name: door_knob
objects.description: round brushed-steel flush door knob/pull on the right side of the white door

objects.name: grey_box_top
objects.description: grey box / storage bin / table-like object at bottom centre; its top surface is where the ball lands
objects.note: rounded corners; sides splay outward toward the bottom of the frame (perspective, seen slightly from above); continues beyond frame bottom

objects.name: door
objects.description: white door filling most of the frame; right edge (dark gap/frame line) at x ~879-885
objects.left_edge_x_px: about 75-90 (faint vertical line on the left)

objects.name: wall_light_spot
objects.description: bright lamp hotspot on the door, centred near (430, 420), ~400 x 250 px; second faint glow above the box near y 850-950

objects.name: door_frame_wall_right
objects.description: textured white wall/door frame strip between door edge (x~885) and the sleeve (x~1030)

events.event: fingers open / release begins (first downward motion of ball)
ball separated from fingers, free fall
events.note: release between frames 5 and 7; ball clearly free by 7

events.event: ball reaches top edge of grey box (contact/impact)
events.note: last frame; ball bottom ~y 1003 just past box top edge y~974; bounce not visible (video ends)

fall_summary_px.x_drift: x decreases steadily from ~565 to ~533 (slight leftward drift, ~1.3 px/frame)
